title: Staff Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase.

Staff Software Engineer 

The Customer Experience sub-organization within Coinbase's Enterprise Applications and Architecture group builds and operates the secure, Tier-1 platforms that power internal investigative and support workflows for approximately 7,000 specialists across CX, Compliance, Legal, Global Investigations, and Trust and Risk. As a Staff Software Engineer, you'll operate as a technical anchor across 8 globally distributed EAA-CX engineering squads, identifying high-leverage AI and developer-experience opportunities, architecting solutions on Coinbase's production AI infrastructure, and driving platform excellence that raises Tier-1 engineering quality across the portfolio.

What you'll do:

  • Own the EAA-CX AI maturity and developer-experience roadmap in partnership with engineering leadership, embedding with squads to surface opportunities, prototyping on Coinbase's existing AI platform, and driving adoption through working demos and feedback loops.
  • Lead platform excellence workstreams that improve reliability, observability, change-failure rate, and operational readiness for Tier-1 systems, partnering with engineering managers to ensure practices persist on the teams.
  • Define build-versus-buy strategy for developer-experience and AI tooling across EAA-CX, evaluating what to build internally, adopt from partner teams, procure from vendors, or retire.
  • Provide Staff-level architectural coverage across squads facing complex challenges, ramping in to land architecture or delivery and ramping off while maintaining portfolio-wide coherence.
  • Build highly reliable, secure distributed backend services with full SLO ownership, observability, and incident response, ensuring automated outputs and production changes are traceable, reviewable, and safe in a regulated environment.

Required Skills and Experience:

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience with a demonstrated track record architecting and delivering large-scale distributed systems, including deep proficiency in backend service design, API development (gRPC, MCP, GraphQL), and scalable microservices architectures.
  • Proven ability to independently lead ambiguous, high-impact technical initiatives from whiteboard to production across multi-team problem spaces, writing high-quality, well-tested code that sets the standard for others.
  • Strong experience with cloud-native infrastructure including AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, event-driven architectures (Kafka, MQ), distributed caching, and SQL or NoSQL databases.
  • Track record building secure, compliant internal tools or platforms with deep appreciation for security controls, access management, audit logging, and data governance in a regulated environment.
  • Experience building or integrating with agentic AI systems including MCP servers, LLM orchestration layers, RAG pipelines, HITL workflows, or evaluation and guardrail frameworks, with proficiency in Go and willingness to work across Python.
  • Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

descriptionHtml:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. As a Complaints Analyst on the Global Complaints team within Customer Experience, you'll investigate and resolve consumer, regulatory, and litigation support complaints to deliver fair outcomes for Coinbase customers. The Global Complaints team is responsible for handling complaints end-to-end across three units, and you'll own assigned cases from intake through resolution, ensuring every customer receives a thorough, accurate, and timely response. This role is fully onsite at Coinbase's Luxembourg office and requires working in the office five days per week.

What you'll do:

  • Investigate and resolve assigned complaints by gathering account data, transaction history, and customer communications, delivering accurate responses within defined SLA timelines
  • Maintain complete case records in Salesforce, including investigation notes, resolution rationale, and customer correspondence, and submit cases for QC review before closure
  • Escalate complex or ambiguous cases to your Supervisor or Complaints Lead with clear documentation of the issue and your initial assessment
  • Flag recurring complaint patterns or potential process gaps to leadership to support continuous improvement across the team
  • Participate in calibration sessions, training, and nesting requirements to stay aligned on evolving quality standards and process updates

Required Skills and Experience:

  • 1-2 years of experience in complaints handling, customer service, or dispute resolution within financial services, fintech, or a regulated industry
  • Demonstrated ability to draft clear, accurate written responses to customer complaints, with experience applying documented procedures and escalation paths in a structured environment
  • Track record of meeting SLA and quality targets in a high-volume, QC-reviewed production environment
  • Proficiency in English (reading, writing, and speaking) with the ability to work defined shift patterns as required by the business
  • Professional-level fluency in French (reading, writing, and speaking) with the ability to investigate and respond to complaints from French-speaking customers
  • Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

We're hiring a Senior Staff Software Engineer to join the Blockchain Platform team within Platform and define the technical vision for the infrastructure that connects every Coinbase product to the broader crypto economy. This team builds and operates the nodes, indexers, wallets, and orchestration systems that power every core crypto action (send, receive, stake, bridge, wrap, and more) across 60+ blockchain networks and 300+ tokens. You'll lead the next generation of architecture for our wallet stack, indexing infrastructure, and asset identifier systems, directly shaping how millions of transactions execute with the speed, cost efficiency, and security our customers expect.

What you'll do:

  • Define and drive the multi-quarter technical strategy for Blockchain Platform, spanning nodes, wallets, indexing, and asset lifecycle, to support new chain integrations, new products, and significant growth in onchain transaction volume.
  • Architect and evolve core platform infrastructure, including nodes, indexers, wallet systems, and liquidity primitives, for high availability, low latency, cost efficiency, and security at global scale.
  • Lead end-to-end design and rollout of large, cross-team architectural initiatives (e.g., wallet stack rearchitecture, indexing stack redesign, asset identifier system), breaking high ambiguity into clear milestones and measurable outcomes.
  • Drive engineering standards for correctness, security, reliability, testing, and observability across all crypto asset operations, including transaction finality, key management, reconciliation, and failure-mode handling.
  • Own data-driven reliability improvements by using observability signals (transaction success rates, node reliability, indexing latency, on-call burden) to identify structural platform gaps and lead systematic remediation.
  • Represent Blockchain Platform in executive and cross-org forums, communicating tradeoffs, aligning stakeholders on strategy, and securing buy-in for high-impact technical bets in areas like Yield and Stablecoins.

Required Skills and Experience:

  • 12+ years of software engineering experience, including 4+ years operating at a staff-plus level designing and scaling high-throughput transaction systems requiring strong auditability, idempotency, and financial precision.
  • Hands-on experience with one or more blockchain protocols at the node or protocol level (e.g., EVM chains, Solana, Bitcoin, L2s), with demonstrated depth in staking infrastructure, bridging protocols, or tokenization systems.
  • Proven track record of leading large-scale, multi-team architectural initiatives from design through production at a company operating critical infrastructure at global scale.
  • Experience applying AI or agent-based automation to reduce operational toil in platform or infrastructure contexts, with measurable results in efficiency or reliability gains.

We sit at the intersection of data engineering, data science and business analytics: we own the source-of-truth financial datasets in Snowflake/Databricks, the pipelines that produce them, and the reconciliation, month-end close, safeguarding and reporting workflows built on top. What you'll be doing:

  • Partner with Accounting and FP&A to support month-end and quarter-end close, building the datasets, reconciliations and reporting that let us close the books accurately and on time.

  • Drive data contracts with upstream engineering teams, mentor Analytics Engineers, and build abstractions (Python packages, UDFs, LLM-assisted tools) that make finance data users more efficient.

What we look for in you:

  • Accounting exposure, either formal (accounting/finance degree or coursework, CPA/CMA) or hands-on work with Accounting/FP&A teams, such as supporting month-end close, reconciliations or financial reporting.
  • Expert SQL (window functions, complex aggregations, optimization) and strong Python (OOP, reusable frameworks). No production ETL or SQL experience = reject.
  • Deep data modeling: designed modular, reusable source-of-truth models (star/snowflake schemas, SCDs) used by many teams.

The ideal candidate is a strategic operator who can translate complex workforce dynamics into clear narratives for senior leadership, build trusted cross-functional partnerships across Ops, Finance, Legal, and Compliance, and plan capacity in environments where AI agents are an active part of the workforce equation. This role is central to our shift from a technically-driven WFM function to a strategic, AI-informed capability that earns a seat at every planning conversation, not just the operational ones.

What you’ll be doing (ie. job duties): 

  • Lead AI-informed capacity planning, incorporating hybrid human-AI staffing models, scenario planning, and automation-driven productivity assumptions into workforce strategy across Compliance lines of business and new product launches.
  • Serve as the senior WFM voice with executive leadership, distilling complex workforce dynamics, forecast risk, and capacity tradeoffs into clear, decision-ready narratives for CX, Finance, and Compliance leadership without hand-holding.
  • Build trusted partnerships across Ops, Finance, Product, Legal, and Compliance, driving alignment on workforce priorities, regulatory planning, and resourcing tradeoffs across competing stakeholder demands.
  • Develop and manage cost models and OpEx forecasts for Compliance Operations, incorporating AI/automation-driven productivity gains and scenario-based risk planning.
  • Identify and drive areas of opportunity across Compliance Operations: gather data, build the business case, communicate recommendations, secure cross-functional buy-in, and lead initiatives from concept through execution.
  • Lead execution of strategic and tactical plans to ensure operational and regulatory targets are met consistently, with clear tradeoff visibility for leadership when capacity or compliance risks emerge.
  • Create multi-scenario staffing plans for Compliance Operations that model tradeoffs between Customer Experience/Service Levels, Employee Experience, Operational Flexibility, Cost Effectiveness, and AI/automation leverage.
  • Extend WFM strategic expertise to adjacent teams (Risk & Controls, Programs, P&E), acting as a center of excellence for resource planning methodology across the broader organization.
  • Periodically brief senior and executive leadership on WFM performance, capacity risk, regulatory readiness, and the strategic direction of the function.

What we look for in you (ie. job requirements):

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in senior Workforce Management, Operations, or Strategic Workforce Planning roles, including direct accountability for regulated or compliance-driven operations in financial services or fintech.
  • Demonstrated stakeholder leadership: proven ability to build partnerships, drive alignment, and influence decisions across Finance, Legal, Compliance, Ops, and senior CX leadership without positional authority.
  • Executive-level communication skills: able to distill complex workforce dynamics, regulatory risk, and capacity tradeoffs into crisp, decision-ready narratives for senior and executive leadership without hand-holding.
  • Expertise in capacity planning, forecasting, and scenario modeling in complex back-office environments, with experience designing staffing models that account for AI/automation-driven productivity assumptions.
  • Experience operating in, or actively transitioning a team toward, an AI-informed workforce model, including planning capacity in environments where AI agents contribute to operational output.
  • Proven drive for operational excellence in regulated environments, able to navigate ambiguity, manage high-stakes compliance requirements, and deliver results under regulatory scrutiny.
  • Strong analytical skill, with a passion for metrics and data; ability to translate quantitative insights into strategic recommendations that influence business decisions.
  • Highly flexible and adaptable to meeting the evolving needs of a high-growth and fast-paced organization with rapidly evolving regulatory and operational conditions.
  • Experience with modern WFM platforms (e.g., Assembled or comparable) and BI tools (e.g., Looker, Hex).

Nice to haves:

  • Experience designing or operating a two-tier model (senior internal strategists + managed BPO execution layer).
  • Familiarity with AI/automation tooling in an operational or WFM context (e.g., agentic workflows, LLM-assisted forecasting, low-code automation platforms).

What You'll Do

  • Support the Singapore CCO in preparing, coordinating, and maintaining materials required for new license applications, including supporting documents, governance materials, regulatory submissions, trackers and responses to follow-up queries.

This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who likes to build. The GFCO Programs team is the end-to-end DRI for the financial crimes compliance operations experience and automation across Coinbase's global product and entity footprint. We design, govern, and continuously improve compliance operations through AI-first principles, ensuring regulatory soundness, protecting Coinbase, and delivering a better experience for our customers.

We partner deeply with Central Compliance, Compliance Technology, Engineering & Architecture (EAA), GFCO Operations, Analytics, Workforce Management (WFM), Financial Crimes Data Intelligence (FCDI), and Legal to translate regulatory obligations and operational opportunities into scalable, durable programs across all compliance workstreams, products, and jurisdictions — including Suspicious Activity Monitoring (SAM), Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD), Screening, and Complaints.

As a Senior Strategic Program Lead, GFCO (L5), you will serve as a independent program owner within GFCO Programs — owning one or more complex compliance program verticals end-to-end. You will operate with a high degree of autonomy, drive alignment with Director+ stakeholders, and lead programs that span several cross-functional teams, including external parties. You will act as a thought partner to GFCO leadership and be the connective tissue between Compliance Technology, EAA, Operations, WFM, and Central Compliance.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Own end-to-end program strategy, planning, and execution for one or more complex GFCO compliance program areas (e.g., SAM/CAR automation, EDD volume reduction, Complaints, Operations, New Jurisdictions & Launches)

  • Lead cross-functional delivery across XFN teams (Compliance Tech, EAA, Ops, WFM, Legal, Analytics) and drive alignment at the Director+ level
  • Translate regulatory obligations, operational gaps, and model performance signals into actionable, prioritized program strategies using an Eliminate → Optimize → Automate framework

  • Author and maintain high-quality strategy and decision documents (P/PSs, RAPIDs, charters) that inform Director/VP-level decision-making
  • Manage the feedback loop between automation outputs, QC findings, alert productivity data, and investigator feedback, driving continuous improvement in both the automation model and upstream alerting systems
  • Lead Code Yellow-equivalent responses within GFCO (e.g., major lookback events, regulatory deadline responses, Sev2 volume surges)

What We Look For

  • 6+ years of program or project management experience, with 3+ years in financial crimes compliance, AML, BSA/AML operations, or a related regulatory domain
  • Demonstrated ability to independently drive large-scale, multi-stakeholder programs in a regulated environment with minimal guidance
  • Deep understanding of AML/CFT program operations, including SAM/TMS, EDD, Screening, and SAR filing workflows, and the technology landscape that supports them (e.g., TMS, CMS)

Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase.

The Data Platform team builds and operates systems that centralize all of Coinbase's internal and third-party data, so teams across the company can access, process, and transform it for analytics, machine learning, and end-user experiences. As a senior engineer, you will work across the full stack of our systems: foundational processing and storage, scalable pipelines, and the frameworks and internal tools that make data easy to use.  

What you’ll do: 

  • Design, build, and operate foundational data services, including storage (cloud warehouse, data lake), orchestration (Airflow), batch processing (Spark, SQL), and streaming (Kafka).
  • Build and maintain data integration and processing SDKs used by internal services and product teams.
  • Design self-service tools so users can manage and troubleshoot their own data pipelines.
  • Build services for data security, observability, quality, cataloging, and lineage.
  • Turn requests from analysts, ML, and security teams into reusable, scalable patterns.

Required Skills and Experience:

  • 5+ years of experience in software engineering, including senior-level ownership.
  • Strong Python, Go, or Java backend development skills.
  • Hands-on experience with data systems or data pipelines.
  • Familiarity with design patterns such as scale-out, caching, key/value, and columnar storage.
  • Working knowledge of SQL and Airflow for operational data analysis.
  • Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

As a Senior Software Engineer within the Security Platform Engineering group, you'll serve as the primary execution anchor for our most critical regulatory and cryptographic initiatives. This team owns Coinbase's Public and Internal Certificate Management based systems, which is the bedrock for all Coinbase systems. You'll lead the development of high-availability services which provide novel certificate needs internally and with external partners.

What you'll do:

  • Lead the architecture and execution of critical cryptographic infrastructure
  • Define technical strategies with a multi-quarter horizon, bringing clarity to highly ambiguous requirements for novel cryptographic solutions
  • Own risky and ambitious initiatives, implementing secure and resilient cryptographic protocols in a high-stakes, zero-trust environment
  • Shape engineering quality practices as a technical anchor and mentor within a team of senior engineers, driving rigorous code reviews and eliminating single points of failure
  • Build alignment and secure commitment from cross-functional partners across Security, Product, and Policy to drive flawless execution

Required Skills and Experience:

  • 5+ years of experience in software engineering with demonstrated success building highly available, distributed systems
  • Deep domain expertise in Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) and applied cryptography, with proven experience operating certificate authorities, automating X.509 certificate lifecycles (issuance, renewal, revocation, and trust-chain distribution), and safely protecting private key material with HSMs or cloud KMS
  • Extensive programming experience in systems languages such as Golang, Java, C++, or Rust, with ability to operate in a Golang-heavy environment
  • Proven track record operating Tier-0 or highly critical infrastructure where system resilience, security, and low latency are absolute prerequisites
  • Demonstrated experience leading a team's technical strategy, architecture, and deliverables for large-scale projects, including navigating complex regulatory requirements and translating them into robust engineering solutions
  • Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

As a Staff Machine Learning Engineer on the Compliance Automation team within the Platform group, you'll build the AI systems that are reimagining how Coinbase executes compliance operations at scale. This team designs and ships Agentic AI solutions that automate compliance processes, from investigation workflows to decision support, replacing manual operations with intelligent, auditable, and measurable automation. You'll own the ML architecture for production compliance agents, driving technical decisions on model selection, grounding, guardrails, and evaluation while partnering with Compliance stakeholders to ensure every automated output meets regulatory standards.

What You'll Do:

  • Architect and build production Agentic AI systems for compliance automation, including LLM-powered agents, orchestration pipelines, and decision support workflows that replace manual compliance processes
  • Own the ML technical direction for compliance agents, driving model selection, prompt engineering, grounding strategies, and guardrail design that ensure agent outputs are accurate, auditable, and regulatorily defensible
  • Design and implement evaluation and measurement frameworks that quantify agent performance, detect hallucinations and drift, and provide the auditability compliance teams and regulators require
  • Partner with Compliance, Legal, and Operations stakeholders to translate complex regulatory workflows into automatable technical specifications, identifying which processes are candidates for full automation vs. human-in-the-loop augmentation
  • Mentor engineers on ML system design, LLM application patterns, and responsible AI practices, raising the team's technical bar for production AI systems

Required Skills and Experience:

  • 8+ years in machine learning and software engineering, with demonstrated experience shipping LLM-based or Agentic AI applications to production
  • Deep expertise in LLM application development, including prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), grounding techniques, hallucination reduction, and agent orchestration frameworks
  • Proven track record building evaluation and measurement systems for ML models in production, including monitoring for drift, accuracy degradation, and output quality at scale
  • Strong Python proficiency with hands-on experience in GenAI frameworks and ML infrastructure (e.g., LangChain, vector databases, Airflow, Spark, or equivalent orchestration and data processing tools)
  • Experience in compliance, regulatory technology, financial crimes, or similarly regulated domains where auditability, explainability, and correctness of automated decisions are critical
  • Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality

title: Customer Support Specialist II
descriptionHtml:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase.

 Insert Standard Intro HERE

As a Customer Success Agent  you will serve as a primary subject matter expert for Coinbase’s products, providing world-class service and support to our most valued customers. You’ll join a team of customer focused support professionals who know their performance is essential to Coinbase achieving its mission. We’re looking for an individual who has a passion for making the customer experience seamless and phenomenal.

What you’ll be doing (ie. job duties):

  • Responsible for providing support for high-profile Coinbase customers across multiple channels (phone, messaging & email) by investigating, troubleshooting and resolving customer issues.
  • Use all available resources to ensure high standards are met and work is carried out in the most efficient manner.
  • Be a trusted advisor, listen and empathize so the customer knows they are valued. Ensure their voices are heard through accurate issue tracking and upstream solutions.
  • Take ownership and use critical thinking to find the root cause and solve the customer issue on the first contact. Where this is not possible, ensure all defects are logged appropriately.
  • Seek opportunities to add value for customers through education, proactivity and clear expectation setting.
  • You will be responsible for providing best in class customer support, handling customers proactively to mitigate issues, handling contacts through to resolution, and  collaborating across teams of subject matter specialists to fix issues with urgency.
  • Model an investigative mentality: utilize data and customer feedback to help address critical customer issues at the root cause and eliminate defects in the customer experience.
  • Proactively identify customer needs before they become an issue to simplify the customer experience, reduce friction, and strengthen trust in Coinbase.
  • Champion clear communication with internal and external partners to align on solutions and drive results.
  • Develop a deep understanding of Coinbase products and ongoing changes in the macro crypto environment so you can guide customers to navigate the quickly moving and ever changing crypto world and unlock additional features, services, and products that benefit their unique profile.

What we look for in you (ie. job requirements):

  • This role requires full-time, in-office presence, five days a week.
  • Willingness to work nights and weekends to support the 24/7 nature of cryptocurrency markets.
  • Motivated by Coinbase’s mission and creating a seamless experience for our highest value customers. 
  • Minimum of 3 years of relevant experience in a customer service or support  role in a fast paced environment including working with high value customers. 
  • Basic knowledge of blockchain, web3, staking, ROI/staking rewards, self-custody, and/or crypto.
  • Flexible and adaptable to meet the evolving needs of a high-growth and fast paced organization.
  • Fantastic communication and relationship management skills, passion for assisting customers to use Coinbase products successfully, and an eagerness to create a community of high value Coinbase power users.
  • Demonstrates the ability to responsibly use generative AI tools and copilots (e.g., LibreChat, Gemini, Glean) in daily workflows, continuously learn as tools evolve, and apply human-in-the-loop practices to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in efficiency, cost, and quality.

Nice to haves:

  • Experience at crypto exchanges or in financial services, ideally in payments, trading operations or technical support.
  • High level of proficiency in cryptocurrency and Coinbase products
  • Experience in training and/or quality auditor roles
  • Experience in Banking, Wealth Management, Corporate Finance, Asset Management or FinTech
  • Understanding of Google apps, JIRA, Salesforce Service Cloud, or Amazon Connect.

Pay Transparency Notice:The target annual base salary for this position can range as detailed below. Total compensation may also include bonus eligibility and benefits (including medical, dental, and vision).

title: Customer Success Team Agent II
descriptionHtml:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase.

At Coinbase, our mission is to increase economic freedom around the world, and we couldn’t do this without hiring the best people. We’re a group of hard-working overachievers who are deeply focused on building the future of finance and Web3 for our users across the globe, whether they’re trading, storing, staking or using crypto. Know those people who always lead the group project? That’s us.

There are a few things we look for across all hires we make at Coinbase, regardless of role or team. First, we look for candidates who will thrive in a culture like ours, where we default to trust, embrace feedback, and disrupt ourselves. Second, we expect all employees to commit to our mission-focused approach to our work. Finally, we seek people who are excited to learn about and live crypto, because those are the folks who enjoy the intense moments in our sprint and recharge work culture. We’re a remote-first company looking to hire the absolute best talent all over the world.

Ready to #LiveCrypto? Who you are:

  • You’ve got positive energy. You’re optimistic about the future and determined to get there. 
  • You’re never tired of learning. You want to be a pro in bleeding edge tech like DeFi, NFTs, DAOs, and Web 3.0. 
  • You appreciate direct communication. You’re both an active communicator and an eager listener - because let’s face it, you can’t have one without the other. You’re cool with candid feedback and see every setback as an opportunity to grow.
  • You can pivot on the fly. Crypto is constantly evolving, so our priorities do, too. What you worked on last month may not be what you work on today, and that excites you. You’re not looking for a boring job.
  • You have a “can do” attitude. Our teams create high-quality work on quick timelines. Owning a problem doesn’t scare you, but rather empowers you to take 100% responsibility for achieving our mission.
  • You want to be part of a winning team. We’re stronger together, and you’re a person who embraces being pushed out of your comfort zone.

As a Customer Success Associate you will serve as a primary subject matter expert for Coinbase’s products, providing world-class service and support to our most valued customers. You’ll join a team of customer focused support professionals who know their performance is essential to Coinbase achieving its mission. We’re looking for an individual who has a passion for making the customer experience seamless and phenomenal.

What you’ll be doing (ie. job duties):

  • Promote customer retention, growth and satisfaction by maintaining positive and long-term customer relationships, including proactively reaching out to customers based on user data, following-up on communications or providing additional education for our highest value customers.
  • You will be responsible for providing best in class customer support, handling customers proactively to mitigate issues, handling contacts through to resolution, and  collaborating across teams of subject matter specialists to fix issues with urgency.
  • Model an investigative mentality: utilize data and customer feedback to help address critical customer issues at the root cause and eliminate defects in the customer experience.
  • Proactively identify customer needs before they become an issue to simplify the customer experience, reduce friction, and strengthen trust in Coinbase.
  • Champion clear communication with internal and external partners to align on solutions and drive results.
  • Develop a deep understanding of Coinbase products and ongoing changes in the macro crypto environment so you can guide customers to navigate the quickly moving and ever changing crypto world and unlock additional features, services, and products that benefit their unique profile.

What we look for in you (ie. job requirements):

  • Willingness to work nights and weekends to support the 24/7 nature of cryptocurrency markets.
  • Motivated by Coinbase’s mission and creating a seamless experience for our highest value customers. 
  • Minimum of 1 year of relevant experience in a customer service or support  role in a fast paced environment including working with high value customers. 
  • Basic knowledge of blockchain, web3, staking, ROI/staking rewards, self-custody, and/or crypto.
  • Flexible and adaptable to meet the evolving needs of a high-growth and fast paced organization.
  • Fantastic communication and relationship management skills, passion for assisting customers to use Coinbase products successfully, and an eagerness to create a community of high value Coinbase power users.

Nice to haves:

  • High level of proficiency in cryptocurrency and Coinbase products
  • Previous experience in tech, crypto, finance, or fintech.

Team/ Role Paragraph: We're looking for an AI-forward operator to lead how our People Operations function runs, including the systems, signals, and service model that power the entire employee experience. This role sits at the intersection of data, automation, and people strategy: you'll use AI and predictive insight to anticipate organizational needs before they become problems, and you'll lead a team that turns those insights into scalable, human-centered solutions.

You'll own the design, execution, and continuous improvement of HR service delivery,  partnering closely within our  People Ops team and with partner teams like IT, Payroll, HR M&A, and HR Business Partners to modernize how we work. This isn't a role about maintaining the status quo; it's about reimagining how a People function should run in an AI-enabled world, faster, smarter, and more responsive to the business.

What you’ll do: 

  • Lead with foresight, not hindsight. Use Jira, Workday, ticketing trends, service-level data, employee experience signals, and capacity data to anticipate where the organization will need to simplify, standardize, automate, or redesign work before issues surface as escalations.
  • Build and scale AI-powered service delivery. Support the optimization of knowledge management, case management, employee lifecycle workflows, embedding generative AI and automation wherever it improves speed, accuracy, and employee experience, while preserving the right level of human judgment, oversight, and compliance.
  • Act as a strategic advisor across the People function. Serve as a trusted partner to our Centers of Excellence, ensuring HR functions operate as one connected system aligned to business priorities, not a set of disconnected processes.
  • Turn ambiguity into operating clarity. Translate complex, cross-functional needs into process maps, requirements, success metrics, operating procedures, and launch plans that route work to the right tier whether automated, self-service, or human-supported.
  • Lead and develop a team, modeling how to use data and AI as a daily decision-making tool, not a side project.
  • Drive measurable outcomes. Continuously tie process and automation investments back to efficiency gains, cost, risk reduction, and employee experience improvements.

Required Skills and Experience:

  • 7+ years of experience in People Operations, HR program management, operations strategy, process improvement, HR technology, or a related field, including complex cross-functional portfolio leadership.
  • A demonstrated track record of using AI and automation to redesign operational workflows at scale in a global organization, not just piloting tools, but embedding them into how work gets done.
  • Strong program management fundamentals: prioritization, governance, dependency management, executive communication, and the ability to drive delivery through ambiguity.
  • Experience partnering with HR technology teams on requirements, testing, data quality, controls, and change adoption for Workday, Jira, or similar platforms.
  • Data-driven, systems level thinker who connects operational metrics to investment decisions, employee experience, risk, and business outcomes.
  • Excellent communication, judgment, and discretion with sensitive employee and business information.
  • Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

descriptionHtml:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase.

As a Deputy MLRO on the Institutional AML/CTF Compliance team, you'll execute anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing programs across Coinbase's international entities, including Coinbase Bermuda Services Limited, Coinbase Bermuda Limited, Coinbase Custody International, and the CBIE Trust. This team protects Coinbase's customers and licenses by maintaining robust AML/CTF controls, transaction monitoring, and regulatory reporting across multiple jurisdictions. You'll act with delegated authority from the Chief Compliance Officer and MLRO, leading day-to-day compliance operations including suspicious transaction reporting, customer due diligence reviews, governance reporting, and regulatory correspondence across Ireland and Bermuda.

What you'll do:

  • Lead day-to-day AML/CTF compliance operations with delegated authority from the Chief Compliance Officer and MLRO, including transaction monitoring, alert review, and escalation of suspicious activity across all covered entities.
  • Drive the development, preparation, and presentation of materials for required AML Compliance Governance Committee meetings, ensuring leadership has clear visibility into program health and risk.
  • Prepare and file Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) and other regulatory filings for assigned entities, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and timely submission to the relevant authorities in each jurisdiction.
  • Conduct customer due diligence (CDD) and enhanced due diligence (EDD) reviews, assessing customer risk profiles and escalating complex or high-risk cases as appropriate.
  • Monitor regulatory developments across Ireland and Bermuda, flagging relevant changes to the MLRO and contributing to policy and procedure updates.
  • Partner with internal teams including CX, Legal, and Operations to ensure consistency in compliance processes and support responses to regulatory inquiries or examinations.

Required Skills and Experience:

  • 6+ years of experience in AML/CTF compliance, financial crimes, or a related compliance function within financial services, fintech, or a regulated entity, with experience operating in a Deputy MLRO or senior compliance role with delegated authority.
  • Working knowledge of AML/CTF legislation in Ireland and/or Bermuda, including the Criminal Justice (Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing) Act 2010 (as amended), CBI guidance, EU Anti-Money Laundering Directives, and/or the Bermuda Proceeds of Crime Act and Bermuda Monetary Authority (BMA) requirements.

descriptionHtml:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase.

As a Customer Support Specialist II, you’ll join a high performing team of passionate support professionals who know their performance is critical to Coinbase achieving its mission. You will dedicate your time to assisting customers and teammates with inquiries, resolving issues, and ensuring a positive experience for our customers. You will serve as a bridge between the customers and the company, offering empathetic, knowledgeable, and efficient support. 

What you’ll be doing (ie. job duties):

  • Responsible for providing support for Coinbase customers across multiple channels (phone, messaging & email) by investigating, troubleshooting and resolving customer issues.
  • Use all available resources to ensure high standards are met and work is carried out in the most efficient manner.
  • Be a trusted advisor, listen and empathize so the customer knows they are valued. Ensure their voices are heard through accurate issue tracking and upstream solutions.
  • Take ownership and use critical thinking to find the root cause and solve the customer issue on the first contact. Where this is not possible, ensure all defects are logged appropriately.
  • Seek opportunities to add value for customers through education, proactivity and clear expectation setting.
  • Set a high bar for Customer Service Agents within the organization by setting an example through performance and work ethic.

What we look for in you (i.e. job requirements):

  • Motivated by Coinbase’s mission and creating a flawless support experience for our global customer base.
  • Shift and weekend work is a requirement.
  • Minimum of 2-3 years of relevant experience in customer support and/or financial services, crypto, technology.
  • Experience with different channels of support, including voice, messaging, and email. 
  • Phenomenal communication skills in order to operate globally across multiple departments and stakeholders.
  • Flexible and adaptable to meeting the evolving needs of a high-growth and fast paced organization.
  • Must be able to read, write and speak in English.
  • Experience at crypto exchanges or in financial services, ideally in payments, trading operations or technical support.
  • Willing to work from an office at Manila, Philippines

Nice to haves:

  • Understanding of Google apps, JIRA, Salesforce Service Cloud, or Amazon Connect.
  • Experience working with and partnering with external business partners.

title: Payments Risk Specialist I
descriptionHtml:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase.

Responsibilities:

  • Conduct detailed reviews of escalated customer accounts to identify and mitigate payments fraud risks, including chargebacks, ACH returns, wire disputes, and account takeovers.
  • Analyze fraud trends and patterns in payment activities, providing actionable insights to Payments Risk management.
  • Collaborate with the Payments Risk investigations team to provide feedback on rule performance and risk logic.
  • Support the development and documentation of review processes to enhance operational efficiency.
  • Identify inefficiencies in workflows and recommend process improvements to mitigate risk exposure.
  • Maintain high standards of accuracy and timeliness in fraud investigations and risk assessments.

Requirements:

  • Minimum of 1 year of experience in payments risk, fraud analysis, or risk operations within financial services or e-commerce.
  • Strong understanding of payments systems, fraud detection methodologies, and risk mitigation strategies.
  • Excellent analytical and investigative skills with the ability to identify patterns and root causes of fraud.
  • Proficiency in English communication, both written and verbal.
  • BA/BS degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, in-office environment.
  • Passion for combating fraud and abuse, with a proactive and detail-oriented approach.
  • Demonstrates the ability to responsibly use generative AI tools and copilots (e.g., LibreChat, Gemini, Glean) in daily workflows, continuously learn as tools evolve, and apply human‑in‑the‑loop practices to deliver business‑ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in efficiency, cost, and quality.

Nice to Haves:

  • Knowledge of blockchain analytics and fraud trends within the cryptocurrency ecosystem.
  • Familiarity with tools and technologies used in payments risk management.

descriptionHtml:

Senior Software Engineer, Tax Engineering

Tax Engineering sits at the intersection of every trade, every payment, and every product Coinbase ships. When a user buys Bitcoin, sells an equity, earns staking rewards, or redeems an Advisor-managed strategy, Tax Engineering is in the critical path, calculating cost basis, tracking gain/loss, determining withholding obligations, and producing compliance reporting across every product line and legal entity globally. As a Senior Software Engineer on the Tax team within the Consumer & Business group, you'll build the extensible primitives that make each new Coinbase launch possible, where scale and accuracy are both non-negotiable.

What you'll do:

  • Own the design and delivery of backend systems for cost basis tracking, gain/loss calculation, withholding automation, and tax reporting infrastructure
  • Build new pipelines for broker reporting, automated withholding, and clearing integrations with partners as Coinbase expands into equities, margin, and options
  • Partner with Product, Design, Tax, Trading, and Positions teams to take ambiguous problems from scoping through production rollout
  • Drive an extensible tax architecture so every new product launch can plug into shared primitives without bespoke rework
  • Strengthen engineering quality through design reviews, code reviews, and technical mentorship across the team

Required Skills and Experience:

  • 6+ years of backend software engineering experience building and operating production systems with high-quality, well-tested code
  • Strong distributed systems fundamentals, with experience designing high-throughput services and data pipelines where correctness is critical
  • Track record owning complex systems end-to-end, from design through production operation, in fast-changing domains
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate closely with product, design, and cross-functional partners to translate ambiguous requirements into shipped solutions
  • Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

The Tax Information Reporting and Withholding Advisory Manager will be an integral part of the Coinbase tax team. The role sits at the intersection of tax advisory, product development, and operational execution, helping Coinbase translate complex U.S. and global tax requirements into scalable processes and systems. This role focuses on strong advisory judgment and practical experience applying information reporting and withholding rules in fast-moving business environments. 

The Coinbase tax team ensures full compliance with tax obligations across all jurisdictions in which Coinbase operates, including building world-class tax protocols for digital asset transactions. We are passionate about tax and crypto, and we are seeking a candidate with a similar passion and collaborative mindset to join our team.   What you'll do:
  • Own end-to-end execution of key information reporting and withholding workstreams, including reporting readiness, withholding calculations, reconciliations, remittance support, and operational issue resolution.
  • Translate tax laws, regulations, and internal policy positions into clear business requirements, logic, and data specifications for technical and operational teams.
  • Review product and process changes to identify tax impacts, define data capture needs, and ensure compliance requirements are addressed early in the development lifecycle.
  • Partner with Tax, Product, Engineering, Operations, CX, and Finance to implement scalable processes supporting U.S. and global compliance.
  • Lead the design and execution of user acceptance testing for tax-related features, workflows, and reporting outputs.
  • Support tax audits, notices, and regulatory inquiries through timely data gathering, reconciliation, and documentation.

Required Skills and Experience:
  • 8+ years of experience in information reporting and withholding within a bank, broker-dealer, fintech, technology company, Big 4, or similar advisory environment.
  • Deep working knowledge of U.S. information reporting and withholding regimes (Forms 1099, 1042-S, 1099-DA, backup withholding, NRA withholding) with familiarity with global regimes such as CRS and CARF.
  • Proven ability to draft business requirements, translate tax rules into implementable logic, and partner with engineering teams to operationalize compliance.
  • Advisory experience from a law firm, Big 4, accounting firm, or in-house tax function, with the ability to explain complex tax requirements clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

Senior Software Engineer, Backend (Consumer - Risk)

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Risk Engineering team within the Consumer & Business group, you'll build and optimize the systems that detect and prevent fraud, manage credit and market risk, and protect millions of users from financial threats in real time at crypto-market scale. You'll provide technical leadership for end-to-end projects, drive architectural decisions that shape our risk detection and mitigation systems, and deliver complex features from inception through production. Your work directly reduces financial loss and keeps Coinbase users safe.

What you'll do:

  • Lead the design and delivery of complex risk platform features end-to-end, from architecture through implementation, deployment, and monitoring, with stringent requirements for correctness, performance, and reliability
  • Drive architectural decisions that shape Coinbase's risk detection and mitigation systems, translating ambiguous business requirements into scalable working architectures that balance fraud prevention with user experience
  • Partner cross-functionally with Data Science, ML, Risk Analysts, Product, and Compliance teams to build proactive systems (real-time decisioning engines, model-driven fraud detection) and reactive solutions (incident response tooling, compliance-driven risk controls)
  • Build AI-native risk systems that leverage fleets of agents to automate complex detection and response workflows, significantly reducing the need for manual intervention
  • Strengthen the team by mentoring engineers, conducting rigorous code reviews, writing technical design documents for complex systems, and championing engineering best practices across the codebase
  • Own system quality and operational excellence by proactively addressing technical debt, driving bug triaging, and leading incident response and post-mortems to ensure platform reliability

Required Skills and Experience:

  • 5+ years of backend software engineering experience with a track record of delivering complex, high-impact systems in production environments
  • Deep proficiency in backend languages (Go, Ruby, Python, or Java) with demonstrated experience designing distributed systems including microservices, event-driven architectures, and REST/GraphQL APIs
  • Proven ability to translate ambiguous requirements into clear technical plans and working architectures, driving technical clarity across engineering, product, and data science teams
  • Track record leading end-to-end projects with long-term impact, including scoping, design, implementation, monitoring, and mentoring other engineers through the process
  • Experience leading incident response, conducting post-mortems, and driving measurable operational improvements in high-availability systems

As a Senior Product Manager on the Payments Platform team within the Platform product group, you'll own how customers add and use bank accounts, cards, and digital wallets on Coinbase. Payments Platform builds and runs the systems that move customer money in and out of Coinbase, covering bank transfers, card payments, wires and real-time rails. Your work sits directly on revenue and customer trust: if a customer can't add a payment method, nothing else happens.

What you’ll do: 

  • Own the multi-year strategy and roadmap for how customers add and use bank accounts, cards, and digital wallets on Coinbase, including the full funnel from first screen through linking, verification, and failure recovery.
  • Drive intelligent routing of payment onboarding across multiple payment service providers and banks, picking the path most likely to succeed and cheapest to run so a single provider problem never becomes a customer outage.
  • Shape the approach for confirming that a payment method belongs to the customer, partnering with Risk and Compliance to hold a measured line on fraud loss versus conversion.
  • Partner with Business Development and external bank and processor partners on commercial terms, integrations, and the next wave of payment capabilities.
  • Lead payment method cost and performance reporting end to end, surfacing tradeoffs to senior leadership and building platform capabilities that other product teams can reuse without rebuilding the plumbing.

Required Skills and Experience:

  • 7+ years of product management experience with depth in payments, money movement, or financial platforms, and a track record of owning a payment or money movement funnel end to end at scale with measurable results.
  • Working knowledge of how card payments and bank transfers actually work, including declines, retries, verification, tokenization, and routing, with the ability to go deep with engineers on service architecture, APIs, and routing logic.
  • Strong analytical instincts, including designing experiments and holding a measured line on tradeoffs when the easy answer and the right answer are not the same.

descriptionHtml:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase.

When crypto moves between exchanges, regulators in most major markets require that customer information travels with the transaction — the same idea as a bank wire. That's the Travel Rule, and Coinbase built TRUST (Travel Rule Universal Solution Technology), the industry's leading Travel Rule network with 200+ member VASPs. As PM, you'll own the platform behind it and the consumer experience in front of it, and you'll grow TRUST as a global standard.

What you'll do:

  • Drive TRUST network growth: sign new VASPs, expand asset and network support, and lead go-to-market to strengthen TRUST's position globally
  • Own the end-to-end Travel Rule experience, from the platform APIs and backend infrastructure to the consumer flows that make compliance feel effortless
  • Shape consumer experiences that make cross-exchange transfers feel easy, transparent, and trustworthy, even while regulatory data exchange happens behind the scenes
  • Partner across product groups so teams that own their own front-end surfaces integrate cleanly with Travel Rule infrastructure
  • Support global expansion by enabling new Coinbase entities and meeting jurisdiction-specific requirements across markets like the EU, UK, and India
  • Strengthen TRUST's privacy and security posture to reinforce Coinbase's position as the most trusted platform in crypto
  • Lead program health and stakeholder alignment across a complex, multi-team domain where you are the single-threaded owner

Required Skills and Experience:

  • 7+ years of product management experience
  • Business development and partnership mindset: you understand how to build a business, grow adoption, and form relationships that expand a platform's reach
  • Experience building platform or API products that other teams integrate with
  • Strong consumer product instincts, with care for an easy-to-use, trustworthy customer experience
  • Demonstrated ability to drive cross-functional alignment across multiple stakeholders
  • Experience with compliance, regulatory, or risk products in fintech or financial services
  • Strong analytical skills, with experience defining success metrics across both platform health and user experience
